fields.description: Never set by the importer — set by a human via the Confirm Name button, or automatically by the classification funnel (see confirmation_source and services/candidate_classification.py).
fields.label: Confirmed

fields.description: The Contact this confirmed name was applied to (see services/candidate_names.py) — the authoritative link used by outreach email generation.
fields.label: Contact

fields.description: Unverified guesses generated at confirmation time from name + Company Profile.domain (see services/email_guessing.py), ranked most-likely first. On a HUMAN confirm only, guessed_email_1 is also pushed onto the linked Contact as its primary email (the outreach recipient); automatic confirmations never redirect the recipient to a guess.
fields.label: Guessed Email 1

fields.description: Combined with Name, reproduces the source SQLite table's own UNIQUE(company_id, name_text, source_document_id) key — used by the importer to detect already-staged rows on re-import without touching confirmed ones.
fields.label: Source Document ID

fields.description: Set by the automated classification funnel (services/candidate_classification.py). Empty = never classified; Error rows are retried on the next run.
fields.label: Classification Status
fields.options:
Auto Confirmed
Auto Rejected
Needs Review
Error

fields.description: Which funnel pass decided: cross-corpus recurrence blacklist, scraped-contact-point email match, or the CLI Claude classifier.
fields.label: Classification Method
Confirmation Source
fields.options:
Human
Auto - Email Match
Auto - LLM

fields.description: Which CLI actually produced this verdict — codex means the primary (claude) failed or hit its subscription usage limit on this chunk and the classifier automatically retried with the fallback CLI.
fields.label: LLM Provider

fields.description: The real scraped contact-point email whose local part corroborated this name (Email Match pass) — safe to use as the outreach recipient, unlike the guessed addresses.
fields.label: Matched Contact Email

fields.description: Set by the deliverability check (services/email_verification.py) against guessed_email_1-6, in order, stopping at the first Verified result. Empty = never attempted; Error rows are retried on the next run.
fields.label: Verification Status

fields.description: The guessed address the verification run tested that produced this status. On Verified, this address is also pushed onto the linked Contact as its primary email (the outreach recipient) — the same promotion used by a Human confirm.
fields.label: Verified Email

fields.description: Raw result string from the verification provider (ok / catch_all / invalid / disposable / unknown), kept for audit alongside the banded verification_status.
fields.label: Verification Result

fields.description: A Catch-All result means the domain accepts everything, so the automatic check can't trust it — click this to have a human promote verified_email to the outreach recipient anyway.
fields.label: Use This Email
